verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph's documented Mail API lets any HTTP-capable agent read, search and filter mail. It also covers triage (flags, importance, categories, Inbox rules), drafting, and sending via sendMail. The evidence shows no first-party agent-native connector for Claude or ChatGPT, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: an official MCP server or connector for Claude/ChatGPT, machine-readable API specs (OpenAPI/llms.txt), independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full read-triage-draft-send loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
